verdict.rationale: Glama provides a searchable registry of thousands of MCP servers with pre-filled config blocks for popular MCP clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code), plus an inspector to test any MCP server's tools and a gateway that fronts deployed servers so agent calls flow through it. Community feedback corroborates active usage of the registry/quality-scoring system, though it also notes friction (undocumented billing gating rescans). Missing for 10: independent third-party validation of tool invocation end-to-end and no evidence of a public API/OpenAPI spec for programmatic integration.
